maplebirch.name: maplebirch Framework
notes: DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED 2026-08-09 (basehead patch broken on v4.1.14): the DOL-X basehead fallback patch hardcoded the minified name of Maplebirch's face-index Set as aP. Upstream renamed that Set to aI in v4.1.14 (let aI=new Set;function aO(e){let t=e.find(e=>aI.has(e))...) and reused aP for an unrelated transformation table (aP={wolf:...,cat:...,cow:...,bird:...}). The emitted srcfn therefore called .has() on that table and threw TypeError: aP.has is not a function on EVERY call. Measured on MuMu 12: direct probes returned THROW for every face style including the empty-options case, and a 40-step real playthrough logged 81 occurrences of 'Error evaluating layer basehead property src'. The v4.1.13 asset is NOT affected - there aP genuinely is that Set - so the already-published 0808 release is unaffected. Fix: lyra/build.py now resolves the identifier out of the asset via MAPLEBIRCH_FACE_INDEX_PATTERN (anchored on the surrounding aO() helper) and fails closed with status face_index_identifier_unresolved when it cannot be proven; the MAPLEBIRCH_BASEHEAD_NEW constant was replaced by _maplebirch_basehead_replacement(identifier). Verified against both real official assets: v4.1.13 resolves aP, v4.1.14 resolves aI, each emits exactly one replacement bound to a proven `new Set`, removes the old needle and keeps the member list unchanged.

CORRECTION 2026-08-09: two earlier claims are withdrawn. (1) The 4.1.14 upgrade note said the compressed identifiers aO/aP 'did not drift'. Only the NEEDLE was checked; the identifier referenced by the REPLACEMENT text was never checked, and aP did drift. Needle-hit and marker-count checks cannot detect this class of defect. (2) A runtime note claimed the basehead patch was live and healthy with the error appearing 'one to three times' as harmless noise. The patched srcfn was throwing on every call, the real count is 81 over 40 renders, and the probe that appeared to confirm eight face styles resolving correctly was reading DoL's vanilla template srcfn on Renderer.CanvasModels - which ignores facestyle entirely - not the patched instance on Renderer.CanvasModelCaches.main.sidebar.

TEST GAP CLOSED 2026-08-09: the suite passed the broken patch because its fixtures synthesised the payload as const faceImagePaths=new Set();const aP=faceImagePaths;, a hand-written alias that made any hardcoded aP reference valid by construction. All three Maplebirch fixtures now embed Maplebirch's real aO() helper, and three regression tests were added: identifier resolution across both naming shapes, a patch run against an aI-renamed payload asserting no stale aP.has survives, and a fail-closed assertion when no face-index Set can be resolved. Local suite is 277 passed.

RUNTIME VERIFIED 2026-08-09 (v4.1.14, AU-F on MuMu 12, PARTIAL): the shipped AU-F APK from CI run 31296592461 (132345566 bytes, formal certificate b21cd15b9ff02d603a20d94b8403d5d9661946518f88e0551474c93ab829ece6) was installed with adb install -r over the 0808 build. maplebirch loaded with IndexedDB schema version 40114 and the required-mod probe returned maplebirch true. Desk pet remount holds: across four navigations over passages confirmed to exist via Story.has (Start -> Orphanage Intro -> Start -> Bedroom) the container returned to 1 child every time with 17587/17588 opaque pixels, matching the clothed macro path rather than the 16316 undressed fallback, so the NPC pregnancy code 4.1.14 newly registers on :storyready does not disturb the remount subscription. The AU face variant patch is live: setup.faceVariantOptions carries all eight registered styles with their real variant names instead of an invalid style/default pair. The pregnancy roster is populated (canBePregnant and canImpregnatePlayer both [Alex, Black Wolf, Great Hawk], pregnancyGenerator [human, wolf, parasite, hawk], plus recordSperm/pregnancyDaysEta/getChildDays). Save round-trip through the game's own IndexedDB layer succeeded with zero thrown errors. IMPORTANT: all of this was measured on the APK carrying the BROKEN basehead patch. The basehead fix has NOT been built or run on a device yet, so status stays static-validated-pending-runtime until a rebuilt APK is verified.

HARNESS ARTIFACTS 2026-08-09 (not product defects): navigating with SugarCube.Engine.play() to a passage that does not exist ('Credits', confirmed absent via Story.has) produced the on-screen alert for a missing passage plus a cascade of <<endcombat>>/<<endevent>>/<<endnpc>>/<<clearnpc>> TypeErrors. Jumping directly into real passages while skipping character creation produced <<doVersionCheck>> and <<attitudesControlCheck>> widget errors, the latter being Cannot set properties of undefined (setting 'unlockExhibitionismUnderwear') because V.attitudes was never initialised. Walking the real start flow instead (Start -> Start2 -> Orphanage Intro -> Bedroom -> Bed -> Sleep, 40 steps) produced zero error banners on those same passages, which classifies both as artifacts of the test harness.

NOT VERIFIED 2026-08-09 (existing-save load): the original verification target was 'an existing 0808 save still loads'. This device holds no game saves - the degrees-of-lewdity IndexedDB saves and details stores both count 0 and idb.getSaveDetails() returns an empty array - so that exact check had no material and is NOT claimed as passing. The profile restore itself did work (localStorage came back with verifiedAge, dolFeats at 8175 chars, maplebirchFrameworkOptions at 1519 chars and maplebirch.character.pet.position), so the empty save store reflects the original 0808 install never having saved, not a failed restore. What was verified instead is a fresh save/load round-trip on v4.1.14, recorded above. Migrating a real long-running 0808 save remains untested.

NOT REACHABLE 2026-08-09 (kaiju mask): the four kaiju_mask() hooks 4.1.14 adds are dead code on 0.5.10.12. The 4.1.13 bundle mentions kaiju 0 times and the 4.1.14 bundle 4 times, always guarded by a costume-name equality test (worn.over_upper.setup.name === "kaiju costume" and the nnpc equivalent). The built AU-F index.html contains the literal string 'kaiju costume' 0 times and the APK ships no kaiju image asset, and a runtime sweep of every clothing/costume table plus the setup namespace found no match. So the new mask path cannot be exercised on this game version and carries no upgrade risk here.

TOOLING GAP 2026-08-09: tools/apk_emulator_smoke_test.py cannot verify this scenario as written. It runs 'pm clear' at line 1215, which destroys the saves a save-load check needs, and it shells out to adb without -s so it aborts with 'more than one device/emulator' whenever a second emulator is attached (ANDROID_SERIAL works around that). Its startup interaction loop also evaluated document.body before SugarCube had run, read the raw inline script text, concluded 'no_startup_gate' and never clicked the localized age gate, so the run recorded expected_passage_not_reached while the game was in fact sitting on the age-confirmation dialog. On this 2 GB device the first attempt additionally ran with roughly 200 MB available and the low-memory killer reaped most background processes mid-run; with about 640 MB free the same build reached the Start passage in roughly 90 seconds.

UPGRADE 2026-08-08: pinned v4.1.13 -> v4.1.14. The recorded digest e44c9aeda62e8cf9cf76a85907c55b8b651541bccb8c6da0ee1b4eda965923a4 (186903 bytes) matches the GitHub Release digest for asset maplebirch-0.5.10.12-v4.1.14.mod.zip, upstream build commit cf57f88c, published 2026-08-02. STATUS IS DELIBERATELY NOT runtime-validated-base: every runtime claim in the notes below was measured on v4.1.13, and v4.1.14 has NOT been run on a device or in a browser yet. The 0 error / 0 warning / 340 info base-stack log and all MuMu 12 pixel counts recorded below belong to v4.1.13 only.

STATIC EVIDENCE 2026-08-08: all three DOL-X patch needles occur exactly once in the 4.1.14 dist/inject_early.js and all three markers occur zero times, so the compressed identifiers aO/aP did not drift and upstream did not fix any of the three defects. Chaining the three patch functions over the real official asset returned patched for each, produced exactly one marker each, removed the old basehead needle, kept the member list and boot.json byte-identical and left the official source file unmodified. Member count is unchanged at 4, dependenceInfo is byte-identical across the two versions with GameVersion still >=0.5.10.12, and addonPlugin is 0 entries in both, so the patch surface against the game body did not widen.

SAVE RISK 2026-08-08: v4.1.14 unseals the framework NPC pregnancy extension, which appends NPC names to setup.pregnancy.canBePregnant and canImpregnatePlayer with no migration or rollback path. Rolling back to v4.1.13 after playing on v4.1.14 leaves that saved pregnancy data with no handler, because v4.1.13 savedPregnancy() returns immediately while disabled. Back up saves before any downgrade. The extension overwrites window.recordSperm, window.pregnancyDaysEta, window.getChildDays and six vanilla macros, none of which is updatesidebarimg, so it does not intersect the DOL-X desktop-pet or basehead patches; both merely share the :storyready event.

RUNTIME 2026-08-05: an AU-F user video captured `Failed to load image img/face/default/base-head.png for layer basehead` while the Maplebirch desktop pet was enabled and the face style changed; the desktop pet can temporarily lose its head. The reporter clarified that the main sidebar model remains normal independently: the desktop pet is a separate fixed-position canvas derived from main-model layers, and only the pet rendering path is affected. This is outside the earlier base-stack 0-error test scope and does not invalidate that narrower evidence

ROOT CAUSE 2026-08-05: v4.1.13 basehead.srcfn passes the face-style candidate and img/body/base-head.png fallback through synchronous resolveFaceImagePath(), but loadImage() normally returns a Promise for uncached paths; the Promise is treated as unknown-but-usable and selects a missing face path on first render

LOCAL PATCH 2026-08-05: DOL-X now uses Maplebirch's fully populated faceImagePaths index for basehead selection, preserving real per-style base-head overrides and falling back immediately to img/body/base-head.png when absent. The fail-closed patch is statically tested and was applied to the official 186010-byte asset with only dist/inject_early.js changed

USER VERIFIED 2026-08-06: CI run 31015066739 built and audited base + AU-F candidates successfully. On MuMu 12, the patched AU-F APK rendered all eight registered face styles with each style's valid first variant through the UI-faithful single updatesidebarimg refresh path: 8/8 desktop-pet canvases were non-empty, no Failed to load image messages, no page errors, and basehead always resolved to img/body/base-head.png. Test state was restored to default/default, pet disabled, mask 25, rotation 0 and scale 1

DESIGN BOUNDARY 2026-08-06: the base candidate desktop-pet canvas contains only the complete small model, while the AU-F canvas also contains a right-side close-up face. Maplebirch intentionally applies a configurable desktop-pet split mask (25px default) to this canvas, so a partly visible large face is an AU canvas-layout plus mask-setting behavior rather than a remaining missing-basehead defect

ROOT CAUSE 2026-08-06 (pet invisible): SugarCube rebuilds StoryFooter on every passage render, so the <div id="maplebirch-character-pet"> that the framework mounted its canvas into is replaced by a fresh empty node. v4.1.13 re-syncs the pet only from the <<updatesidebarimg>> wrapper registered in Character.preInit(), and a passage change does not necessarily run that macro, so an enabled pet stops appearing while the framework still holds the detached old container. Proven on MuMu 12 by tagging the live container: after a passage render the live node carried no probe tag and 0 children, while pet.container still had the old tag, was detached from the document and kept 1 child. This also explains the intermittent flicker the user reported - unrelated option events happened to fire the macro, the pet appeared, and the next passage removed it again.

RULED OUT 2026-08-06: the earlier hypotheses of an Android WebView compositor failure, a CSS mask clipping the pet, and out-of-viewport stored coordinates are all disproven. With the fix the container reports position fixed at 673,130 with size 256x256, elementFromPoint at its centre hits the pet canvas, and the pet is visible in a device screenshot.

LOCAL PATCH 2026-08-06: DOL-X subscribes the framework's own :passagedisplay event to its own wrapped <<updatesidebarimg>> macro, guarded so it only acts when the pet is enabled and the live container is empty. The macro path is mandatory rather than a direct pet.sync(): Pet.draw() reads clothing from Renderer.CanvasModelCaches.main.sidebar and silently falls back to model.defaultOptions(), an undressed model, when that cache is missing. Measured on MuMu 12: direct pet.sync() on a fresh passage produced 16316 opaque pixels with no sidebar cache, while the macro path produced 17588 with clothing layers present. The user caught this exact regression from a screenshot showing the pet undressed, which is why the patch was changed before release.

USER VERIFIED 2026-08-06 (pet remount): on the live AU-F build, three consecutive passage renders each restored the pet automatically with 1 child element and 17588 opaque pixels, with the framework container no longer detached. Without the subscription the same navigation left 0 children and 0 opaque pixels. Patch applied to the official 186010-byte asset changes only dist/inject_early.js, keeps the member list and boot.json byte-identical, leaves the source archive hash f5161eed8a4828baac8d7667ad4311fa214f02855c32c190ac1087902e9be955 intact, writes the marker exactly once and reports already_patched on a second pass.

UPSTREAM 2026-08-06: v4.1.14 is the only release newer than the pinned v4.1.13; its Pet.ts is byte-identical (12185 chars, identical hash) and Character.ts keeps the same :storyready + <<updatesidebarimg>> pet wiring, so upgrading does not fix the passage remount gap. No upstream report matching a non-visible desktop pet was found. CORRECTION 2026-08-08: the earlier claim that the upstream repository has 8 issues is wrong - the issues endpoint returns an empty list, so there is no upstream issue corpus to cite either for or against this defect.

E2E VERIFIED 2026-08-07: CI run 31139740695 built the then-current candidates and the shipped AU-F APK (132345566 bytes) was installed with adb install -r, preserving firstInstallTime 2026-07-20. Both AU-F and base APKs embed the same patched Maplebirch payload (sha256 23d19b975d6116a9a292804299c2bae857c8e6bf721f9aa32809b010f089ca2b) with the basehead marker once, the pet remount marker once, the <<updatesidebarimg>> macro call present and the old basehead needle gone. With no helper logic injected, four consecutive passage renders each remounted the pet automatically: 1 child element, 17587 opaque pixels, container not detached, sidebar cache populated, 0 page errors and 0 console errors. The 17587 count matches the clothed macro path rather than the 16316 undressed fallback. Note run 31121776690 failed earlier only because GitHub never allocated a runner and cancelled it after 15 minutes with an empty step list; it was not a code or test failure.

SUPERSEDED BY 2026-08-08: the release candidate is now commit cf60d15 published as v0.5.10.12-1.0.8a-0808. Branch run 31239491888 and the full four-code release-tier dry run 31239641405 both concluded success on headSha cf60d154, verified through the GitHub API on 2026-08-08. All eight artifacts passed the stricter audit and the four APKs carry the formal signing certificate b21cd15b9ff02d603a20d94b8403d5d9661946518f88e0551474c93ab829ece6. The desktop-pet remount and basehead findings above still hold; only the candidate identity changed.

more_love.name: 更多恋人
notes: Standalone feature with no dependency on other mods; downloaded via a pinned download_url in build.toml
Compatible with every imagepack combination
UPGRADED v0.1.6.0 -> v0.1.7.0 (2026-08-02). This is a bug fix, not an optional bump

The author README publishes a game-to-mod version table: games on v0.5.10.x must use mod v0.1.7.0, while v0.1.6.0 targets v0.5.7.x. This project ships game body 0.5.10.12, so the previous v0.1.6.0 pin was a version mismatch rather than a conservative choice

Upstream issue #1 'about the red error when viewing food preferences after v0.5.10.12' documents the consequence of that mismatch. The author replied the same day that the 0.5.10 compatible build was published, which is v0.1.7.0

Root cause is upstream game renaming, and all five points were verified present in the v0.1.7.0 package: setup.plants became setup.foodstuff, ingredients moved under recipe.ingredients, the tendingicon macro was removed in favour of foodstufficon which takes a key instead of an icon path, $plants became $foodstuff, and the souffle key lost its accent so Avery no longer fails alone
Change surface is narrow: only boot.json, game/foodPreference.js, game/more_love_interest_food_preference.twee and game/more_love_interest_main.twee differ, with no files added or removed

main.twee also gains a behavioural cleanup: Avery is removed from $loveInterestList when $auriga_artefact is absent or Avery is dismissed. This is an intentional upstream state fix, worth watching on existing saves that already had Avery set as a love interest

RISK RECHECK: the five addonPlugin replacement rules (three TweeReplacer rules on Widgets Attitudes / Widgets, two ReplacePatcher rules on time.js) were fingerprinted in both versions and are byte-identical, so the upgrade does not change this mod's patch surface against the game body. The earlier concern that these rules were the upgrade risk was incorrect
GameVersion requirement tightens from >=0.5.5.0 to >=0.5.10.0, satisfied by the shipped 0.5.10.12
RUNTIME 2026-08-04: user confirmed the More Love panel appears on the actual Attitudes passage, the food-preference link opens, and the no-love-interest empty state renders without a red error box

RUNTIME BOUNDARY: the tested save had no love-interest NPCs, so actual setup.foodstuff, recipe.ingredients, foodstufficon and Avery/souffle rendering remain unexercised; this is partial runtime validation rather than full feature coverage
